title: Winrate Tracker
description:
Winrate Tracker tracks your winrate over time!  Amazing!

Features include:
- Shows reports based on actual run history per-profile and per-ascension.
- Calculates total winrate and splits (per-month, per-patch, per-10 game samples, per-50 game samples).
- Per-character and time period filters.
- Per-card and per-relic winrates.
- Time of day splits (I'm better in the evening, which is odd!)
- Charts and graphs!  They're not that exciting, really, but they exist.
- Can optionally exclude floor 1 abandons.

Project source on Github here:  https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-winrate-tracker

Winrate Tracker currently works with version 0.111.0 on the beta-branch only.
changeNote:
A visual refresh of the whole screen.

- Overview is now Home: your last fifty runs as the headline, a trend chart, your last ten runs as pips, and every character's recent form side by side. Press a character to narrow the screen to them.
- Hover any run pip for that run — character, ascension, when, how long, and how it ended.
- Hover a card or relic to see the real card or relic.
- Search cards and relics by name.
- Filters are drop-downs now, and all of them fit one row.
- Tables show rarity and character icons, alternating rows, and a bar putting each row against your own average.
- Opens on the highest ascension you have played.
